legend: One day at their grandparents' house, Ana and Beto found a very strange deck of cards. This deck consisted of $$$M$$$ cards, each containing an integer, some of which were repeated. Not knowing what the cards were for, they decided to invent a game to pass the time. The rules of the game are as follows:
Ana starts the game by choosing a card from the deck and writing down its number.

Then, they take turns playing alternately, each choosing an unplayed card from the deck such that its sum with the number written down by the other player in the previous turn is a power of two minus one. That is, if the number written down by the other player in the previous turn is $$$x$$$, then the current player must choose a card with a number $$$y$$$ such that $$$x + y = 2^k - 1$$$ for some integer $$$k  \gt  0$$$. Once chosen, they write down the number $$$y$$$.
The game ends when a player cannot choose a card that satisfies the above condition. The player who cannot choose a card on their turn loses the game.
Given the initial deck of cards, determine who will win the game assuming both players play optimally.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$N$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 10^{6}$$$), the number of distinct values on the cards in the deck.

The $$$i$$$-th of the following $$$N$$$ lines contains two integers $$$A_i$$$ and $$$C_i$$$ ($$$1 \le A_i, C_i \le 10^{9}$$$), indicating that there are $$$C_i$$$ cards with the number $$$A_i$$$ written on them. The total number of cards in the deck is $$$M=C_1+C_2+\ldots +C_N$$$.
It is guaranteed that all $$$A_i$$$ are pairwise distinct and sorted in strictly increasing order, that is, $$$A_1  \lt  A_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  A_N$$$.
output: A single line containing the name of the winning player if both play optimally: Ana if Ana wins, or Beto otherwise.
note: In the first example, the deck consists of the cards $$$[2, 5, 5, 10]$$$. If Ana chooses the card with $$$10$$$, then Beto chooses one of the cards with $$$5$$$ (he can do so since $$$5+10=15=2^4-1$$$). Next, Ana can only choose the card with $$$2$$$ (since $$$5 + 2 = 7 = 2^3 - 1$$$ and $$$5 + 5 = 10$$$, which is not a power of two minus one), and Beto chooses the other card with $$$5$$$. At this point, Ana cannot choose any card because there are no cards left in the deck, so Beto wins. It can be shown that if Ana chooses a different card on her first turn, Beto also has a winning strategy.
In the second example, the deck consists of the cards $$$[1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4]$$$. Ana can win if she chooses a $$$1$$$ on her first turn.

legend: 一天，在祖父母家，安娜和贝托发现了一副非常奇怪的纸牌。这副牌由$$$M$$$张牌组成，每张包含一个整数，其中一些是重复的。由于不知道这些卡片是干什么用的，他们决定发明一种游戏来打发时间。游戏规则如下：
安娜开始游戏时，从牌堆中选择一张牌，并写下它的号码。
然后，他们轮流轮流玩，每人从牌组中选择一张未使用的牌，使其与前一回合其他玩家写下的数字之和为2减1的幂。也就是说，如果另一个玩家在前一回合写下的数字是$$$x$$$，那么当前玩家必须选择一张带有数字$$$y$$$的卡片，这样$$$x + y = 2^k - 1$$$就会变成整数$$$k  \gt  0$$$。一旦被选中，他们写下数字$$$y$$$。
当玩家不能选择满足上述条件的牌时，游戏结束。轮到不能选牌的玩家输掉游戏。
给定最初的一副牌，假设两位玩家都玩得最好，确定谁将赢得游戏。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$N$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 10^{6}$$$)，表示牌组中不同值的数量。
下面的$$$N$$$行中的$$$i$$$包含两个整数$$$A_i$$$和$$$C_i$$$ ($$$1 \le A_i, C_i \le 10^{9}$$$)，表明存在写有数字$$$A_i$$$的$$$C_i$$$卡片。牌组中的总牌数为$$$M=C_1+C_2+\ldots +C_N$$$。
保证所有$$$A_i$$$都是成对不同的，并按严格递增顺序排序，即$$$A_1  \lt  A_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  A_N$$$。
output: 一行包含获胜玩家姓名的文字，如果双方都表现最佳：如果安娜获胜，则输给安娜，否则输给贝托。
note: 在第一个示例中，这副牌由$$$[2, 5, 5, 10]$$$牌组成。如果Ana选择具有$$$10$$$的牌，则Beto选择具有$$$5$$$的其中一张牌(他可以这样做，因为$$$5+10=15=2^4-1$$$）。接下来，ANA只能选择具有$$$2$$$的卡(因为$$$5 + 2 = 7 = 2^3 - 1$$$和$$$5 + 5 = 10$$$不是2减1的幂），Beto用$$$5$$$选择另一张牌。此时，安娜无法选择任何一张牌，因为牌组中没有剩余的牌，因此贝托获胜。可以证明，如果安娜在她的第一轮选择不同的牌，贝托也有获胜的策略。
在第二个例子中，该牌组由纸牌$$$[1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4]$$$组成。如果安娜在第一回合选择$$$1$$$，她就可以获胜。
